name: Rare LSASS Process Access Attempts
description: This hunt identifies instances where a process attempts to open the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS) memory and where the number of occurrences is limited to one unique agent and a low number of attempts. This may indicate either a rare legitimate condition or a malicious process attempting to obtain credentials or inject code into the LSASS.
hypothesis: A process that opens LSASS memory on a single host, and only a handful of times in the window, may be credential dumping or code injection rather than routine security software.

analystNotes: Based on the process.executable and process.name you can pivot and investigate further for the matching instances.
Potential false-positives include rare legitimate conditions that may trigger this behavior due to third-party software or LSASS crashing.
expectedFalsePositives: Third-party security, backup or monitoring software that legitimately reads LSASS.
LSASS crash handling and Windows Error Reporting.
suggestedPivots: Pivot on process.executable and host.id to see every access by that binary.
Check the process code signature, parent process and command line.
Look for dumper artifacts (dump files, comsvcs.dll MiniDump, procdump) on the same host.

query.query:
from logs-endpoint.events.api*
| where event.category == "api" and host.os.family == "windows" and process.Ext.api.name in ("OpenProcess", "OpenThread", "ReadProcessMemory") and
 Target.process.name == "lsass.exe"
| keep @timestamp, process.executable.caseless, host.id
 /* normalize process paths to reduce known random patterns in process.executable */
| eval process = replace(process.executable.caseless, """([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|ns[a-z][A-Z0-9]{3,4}\.tmp|DX[A-Z0-9]{3,4}\.tmp|7z[A-Z0-9]{3,5}\.tmp|[0-9\.\-\_]{3,})""", "")
| stats occurrences = count(process), agents = count_distinct(host.id), last_seen = max(@timestamp) by process
| where agents == 1 and occurrences <= 10
query.surroundingEventQuery:
from logs-endpoint.events.api* METADATA _index, _id
| where @timestamp >= {{param.bucket_start}} and @timestamp < {{param.bucket_end}}
| where event.category == "api" and host.os.family == "windows" and process.Ext.api.name in ("OpenProcess", "OpenThread", "ReadProcessMemory") and
 Target.process.name == "lsass.exe"
| eval process = replace(process.executable.caseless, """([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|ns[a-z][A-Z0-9]{3,4}\.tmp|DX[A-Z0-9]{3,4}\.tmp|7z[A-Z0-9]{3,5}\.tmp|[0-9\.\-\_]{3,})""", "")
| where process == {{param.process}}
| sort @timestamp desc
| keep _index, _id, @timestamp, host.name, user.name, process.executable, process.Ext.api.name, process.parent.executable, process.command_line
